extracted.name: Stir-fried cumin carrots
extracted.description: Pair lightly spiced baby carrots with a zesty lemon, shallot, cumin and coriander dressing to make this fabulous side dish - a great accompaniment to your Sunday roast
ingredient_lines: 400g baby heritage carrots washed, leafy tops trimmed and roughly chopped (set aside for later), large carrots halved
1 lemon zested, plus a squeeze of juice
instruction_lines: Mix all the dressing ingredients together and set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok, then add the carrots. Stir-fry for 3-4 mins until lightly charred, then add the garlic, cumin, chilli and a large pinch of salt. Cook for 2 mins more. Turn off the heat, toss through the dressing and a few chopped carrot tops, then serve.
